text:
taylor: Quick sync 1: need final offerId mapping + hero images + EULA snippet for AWS/GCP/Azure listing. Can we close this today?

mina: I can finish the offerId mapping but need the Azure planId shape. Is it offer + plan or nested plan objects?

raj: Azure wants separate offerId and planId fields. I'll produce a CSV with columns: sku, cloud, offerId, planId, visibility.

oliver: Asset note: AWS hero must be <=1MB (3:2), GCP banner 16:9. asset-bot validated current files but I need final filenames and alt text.

legal-bot: automated-check: 14-day trial ok. Please include data-retention language and KMS mention for private offers.

mina: I'll set trial to 14 days. Where should we link the deletion policy? product/privacy-faq.md?

raj: Yes, link to product/privacy-faq.md and add: "Data deletion on request; processed within 30 days."

taylor: Actionables: 1) Raj CSV with Azure planId + cloud offerIds (1pm). 2) Oliver upload compressed hero images + alt text (2pm). 3) Mina paste EULA snippet with placeholders filled (3pm). 4) Publish-bot to run staging publish once assets + manifest are ready.

publish-bot: staging-publish queued: bundle-501. Waiting on manifest.csv and assets.

oliver: Uploading compressed images now: https://drive.redwood.example/marketplace/1820/assets. Filenames include alt text in meta.

mina: Dropped EULA draft here: https://docs.redwood.example/legal/eula-marketplace-1820.md  includes trial term and data retention line; legal-bot please verify.

legal-bot: automated-check: EULA draft contains required clauses. Manual review scheduled if any edits.

raj: CSV uploaded: https://drive.redwood.example/marketplace/1820/mapping.csv  includes RED-TRIAL and RED-PRO with cloud-specific offerId/planId. Marked RED-BETA-LEGACY excluded.

taylor: Excellent. If publish-bot confirms staging deploy, we'll run final preflight tomorrow 10am PT. Thanks all :thumbsup:
